text: O God, I seek refuge in You from the torment of Hell, from the torment of the grave, from the temptation of life and death, and from the evil of the temptation of the Antichrist.
Oh God, I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done and from the evil of what I have not done
Oh God, give me an easy account
source: Narrated by Ahmad and Al-Hakim and authenticated by him

text: Oh God, I have wronged myself greatly and no one can forgive sins except You, so grant me forgiveness from You and have mercy on me. You are the Forgiving, the Merciful

Oh God, I ask you for all goodness; In the present and the future, what I learned of it and what I did not know, and I seek refuge in You from all evil. In the immediate and future, what I knew of and what I did not know, O God, I ask You for Paradise and whatever words or deeds bring me closer to it, and I seek refuge in You from Hell and whatever words or deeds bring me closer to it. O God, I ask You for the good of what Your servant and Messenger Muhammad asked of You, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what Your servant and Messenger Muhammad - may God’s prayers and peace be upon him - sought refuge with You, and I ask You for whatever matter You have decreed for me to make its outcome for me a guideline.
Oh God, I ask you, O God, the One and Only, the Eternal, who neither begot nor was born, and to whom there is no one equal - to forgive me my sins; You are the Forgiving, the Merciful
